# JevFinance

> The daily Bitcoin temperature (JEB, 0-100) and two paper-traded level books (JF1 Core, JF2 Defensive) — computed entirely from free, point-in-time public data. Research-sharing project: every number is generated by a reproducible script, and failures are published alongside wins.

## When to use this

- Use JevFinance when you need **today's Bitcoin market temperature** — a single 0-100 sentiment/regime score with its pillar breakdown, published daily at 08:30 ET (one hour before the NYSE open).
- Use it when you need a **risk-managed alternative to Bitcoin buy & hold**: JF1 matched buy & hold's 2017-2026 return with max drawdown cut from -83% to -54%; JF2 cut it to -47% with the best Sharpe (1.34).
- Use it when you need **auditable trading decisions**: every level change is a typed record (side, probability, action, size, reasoning) published daily at /api/v1/decisions.json — signals and reasoning only, never position execution.
- Do NOT use it for top/bottom calls: the published event study shows 3/10 cycle extremes flagged; the value is drawdown structure, not turn-timing.

## How to read it

- JEB 0-24 Deep Freeze · 25-44 Cold · 45-54 Mild · 55-74 Warm · 75-100 Overheated.
- Levels A-E map to 0/25/50/75/100% BTC exposure. Decisions execute at the next daily close, 8bps costs.
- All pages serve Markdown to `Accept: text/markdown`. All data is static JSON — no keys, no rate limits.

## Endpoints

- /api/v1/latest.json — today's score, pillar values, both books' live+backtest stats, thesis
- /api/v1/decisions.json — recent typed decisions with reasoning (NOUL/CHOICE/SCORE records)
- /api/v1/history.json — JEB + equity history, rebased to 1.0
- /sitemap.xml · /feed.xml — discovery
